notes.title: Legends Of Iona RPG - SOON TO BE FREE?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, long time no see! ːsteamhappyː

Iona was made over a long period of 10 years, with volunteers, part time workers. The lead was driven by pure passion and countless hours of management, production and touch ups. It is many years and lifetime wholehearted investment in this passion game.

The reason why the game took so long to publish is that we developed our own 3D engine and tools called the Decoy3D engine and developed the game part time over 10 years. After 5 years, we decided to test many engines, (CryEngine*, Unreal* 3) and decided for practicality to switch to the Unity3D* engine because of its vast exporting features that Decoy3D did not have. 

The game is inspired from classic RPGs like Shinning the Holy Ark* on the Saturn, Zelda*, Some colorisation styling from games like WoW*, labyrinths and guards, found in games like Phantasy Star* 1987. (We are big fans!)  

We want to give a big thanks everyone that worked on this project and for their support. The goal for this game was that if it was a hit, that we could hire more people and create jobs. We also recognized that the  camera controls and the game art is not top AAA, so we started to work on a second version that was promising but was not able to complete it because of lack of funding. Here is why, after years of efforts and development, we were victims of an unrelated and unfair organized smear campaign and the community that was growing around the game died shortly. But since two years, things calmed down. Maybe it is time to give Iona a second chance? 

This game is unique and we wanted to share it with everyone! We wanted to give back to the gaming community and release the game for FREE! Yes for FREE!  

We sincerely hope that it is appreciated. We are waiting for Steam to enable the new pricing status for the Legends Of Iona RPG game.

Let's play Iona! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Big upgrade?
notes.notes:
Hello gamers!

Ok we uploaded one last version before the big update. The big update will be in a while. Here's why:

-The new controls and camera are almost implemented but would work way better on Unity 2017-18.
-The current version of Iona is on Unity 4.7! So we need time to port all the way to 2017-18. This wont be easy but we need smooth animations and post rendering features.
-We have assembled a team and time to make the needed 3D facelift on level 1-2! It will go under production in a week. The new team is now working on ZBrush and Substance Painter not only 3dsmax.
-We have a experience artist that will redo all the UI, get ready for a major change!
-After all this, yes, we will redo the teaser. 


Stay tuned!

notes.title: Play before and after the big upgrade
notes.notes:
Hi, gamers!

Before a big upgrade on the camera and controls, we are making a major discount on the game for only 8 days, starting on Feb 20 tomorrow!

During the next days, you will see a big change in the gameplay from the current version to new controls and camera. Some had complained that the character moves are stiff and tank like. That is because it was designed to fit in retro gaming style. But, since we are making efforts to make our gamers happier... well we are programming a big upgrade on this issue and soon it will be available to all.

notes.title: Steam controller SETUP update
notes.notes:
For those using Steam Controllers, the current most accurate config is now "Dev Controller". This update is to please a recent demand of our dear user: AKBAAR :-)

This will have a great impact on the appreciation of the game!!! The new config imitates the XBOX controller setup that was designed for this type of game.

We are still looking at making the mouse movement slower. Write us if you know how! We will write on this post if there is an update.

Hitting monsters do not need mouse pointing. If the mouse is not on a button but rather on the gameplay, the X attack will automatically hit the closest encounter.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30281093/be9d8e06e47301b598f6d9c2e60d8e779774f0a9.jpg[/img]

-Hidden buttons under the controller are to adjust first-person to third-person view.
-XYAB Hit/select, run, walk, dodge. Answer EBS questions. X+y,a,b special attack.

-Top left control pad: select/pick shortcut

-Top right control pad: Mouse

notes.title: Who is Madam Djolet ? We are waiting for you on level 4 / 5 !
notes.notes:
This cool old lady lives in the big city in level 4 / 5 in Legends Of Iona RPG.

Many of the side quests in the city go through her since she knows all the gossip about everyone living there.

The name djolet originates from the Haitian Creole meaning: Talk too much.

We dare you to get to level 4 and meet her!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30281093/d28e1963ceef40aae9f624b1b808ced5c3089cf8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: IONA now with full CONTROLLER FULL SUPPORT
notes.notes:
Hi, gamers!  

We need a few controller configurations to share with others!

A default one has been published for the Steam Controller but we need someone to share a version that resembles more the XBox controller config with the XYAB mapping for the EBS and everything around it.

Thanks to the devs and the community Steam controller and Legends Of Iona are fully supported. 

If we make good sales we want to hire a student to help us with the game and make the game available in other languages. Hoping we can get encouragement and good reviews would be appreciated.

Here is a screenshot of the game on a TV not showing any partial controller support anymore.

notes.title: We challenge YOU to complete this new game
notes.notes:
In order to enjoy this game: This game is good, but has a slow build-up you need to be patient since it is an RPG. 

You need to play at least through level 3/5 to understand the complete coolness about it. Level five showcase all features and special moves. 

*We challenge YOU to complete this game*. Remember you will understand the fun about the EBS questions only through playing it yourself. And at all times you can disable the questions or adjust the subjects you prefer. Click on Zaak's brain!

Other News: UI simplification of quests is coming. 4 big boss will be improved and harder to defeat. Level UP arrow for beginners will now appear to help new players to upgrade their stats. Stay tuned!
